data.message: I commit to 18 tons and invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra now if fulfilled. If k choose18 and all others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Even all18 leaves50, but recovery isn't guaranteed and long-run income may suffer. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. Each person: exact intended catch, and does it depend on others?
